summary.title: Technology Due Diligence Checklist
summary.one_liner: A long checklist of questions AKF uses to assess a company's technology, scalability, process, operations, organization and security during investor or acquirer due diligence.
takeaways: The checklist covers AI/ML strategy and execution, scalability, fault isolation, cost, product and delivery process, development, operations, organization, and security.
Scalability questions are framed using the AKF Scale Cube X, Y, and Z axes (load balancing and read/write splitting, service and data separation, and sharding or tenant partitioning).
Development and operations items include CI, continuous deployment, feature flags, rollback, logging, monitoring, incident and postmortem practices.
The checklist is meant to be combined with an end-to-end interview approach rather than used alone, and AKF states it is evolving with technology.
summary.summary: This page from AKF Partners publishes the checklist its team uses in technology due diligence for investors and strategic acquirers, drawn from more than 15 years of work. It is organized into sections: AI/ML strategy, execution and differentiation; scalability along the AKF Scale Cube axes; fault isolation; cost-effectiveness; product management; the product development lifecycle; development process; operations; organization and alignment; and security. Each section is a list of yes/no style or open questions to ask the evaluated company, with no scoring or answers provided. The page notes the checklist should be paired with an end-to-end discussion approach described in a separate post.
